figurative_meaning_en: power of destiny, strength of luck, overwhelming good fortune
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কপালজোর, লটারিতে প্রথম পুরস্কার জিতল।
example_sentences_in_english: His power of destiny shone through; he won the first prize in the lottery.
With overwhelming good fortune, all obstacles cleared away.
history: The idiom is linked to the proverb 'কপালজোরে গোপাল মেলে', referencing Gopal (Krishna) in Bengali folklore, symbolizing divine favor through fate.
note: Often used to attribute success to predestined luck rather than effort.
